R18 B.Tech. CSE Syllabus
DATABASE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS
COURSEOUTCOMES
At the end of the course, the students will develop ability to
1.
Comprehend the basic concepts of DBMS in comparison of File Systems and design
Entity Relationship Models.
2. Identify the constraints to be used on different relation models.
3.Apply various Normal Form that need be used on data base tables.
4. Analyse various concurrent execution and recoverability techniques to be used on
database tables.
Compare various indexing methods to define storage techniques.
